algorithm_name_zh: 多视角混合遗传搜索—自适应大邻域强化算法
compute_contract: Primary comparison matches nominal wall-clock search time (2.0 s). MVHGS-ALNS uses three concurrent population workers, so it is not CPU-equal; aggregate CPU search upper bound is 5.6 s. This must be disclosed and later paired with a CPU-balanced sensitivity before a formal efficiency claim.
gate: On the three frozen cases, MVHGS-ALNS must have zero strict losses and at least one strict win against each of CV-only PyVRP-HGS, naive heterogeneous-EV PyVRP-HGS, and project ALNS.
no_rescue: Do not change seconds, worker count, seed, or route proxy constants after results.
Do not promote one-seed results to a formal China81 claim.
